fields.Name: T84 - Certifications Type Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Certification Type's related Certifications can be reached from the full record form and that certification rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Certification Types' entity from the entity tree. Select 'Certified Cheese Professional' (or any certification type) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. On that form, locate the related Certifications section/tab and view it, confirming certification rows are displayed (or a valid empty-state). Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Certification Type full record form is open showing type detail fields
The related Certifications section/tab is visible with certification rows (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
